# OK (Odnoklassniki)

> > OK (Odnoklassniki) is a Russian social networking platform connecting classmates and friends, featuring original video content, game streaming, and community groups.

OK offers social networking services with integrated entertainment including the original comedy sitcom 'Пять с плюсом' (5+), live game streaming for popular titles like Dota 2, CS:GO, League of Legends, and Hearthstone, plus thousands of community groups covering topics from health to local government.

## Key Topics

- Odnoklassniki social network
- Game streaming (Dota 2, CS:GO, League of Legends, Hearthstone)
- Esports and live broadcasts
- Original content: Пять с плюсом (5+) sitcom
- Community groups
- Russian social media platform
- Classmate connections
- Gaming platform
- Video content
- Moscow-based
- User profiles
- Group chat features
- Entertainment hub

## Core Platform

- [OK social network. Communication with friends on OK. Your meeting place with classmates](https://ok.ru): Homepage for OK/Odnoklassniki social network - connect with classmates

## Entertainment & Original Content

- [Online game broadcasts. Game progress streams. | OK](https://games.ok.ru/): Game streaming platform for Dota 2, CS:GO, LoL & Hearthstone broadcasts
- [Сериал Пять с плюсом (5+) 2021 год от Одноклассников. Итоги 1 сезона комедийного ситкома ОК.](https://fiveplus.ok.ru/): Original OK comedy sitcom '5+' - Season 1 recap & info page

## Community Groups & Organizations

- [A1 Беларусь | Group on OK](https://ok.ru/a1belarus): A1 Belarus telecom provider group - mobile devices, smartphones & services
- [ABC.RU — Шоппинг-лоукостер | Group on OK](https://ok.ru/abcru): ABC.RU shopping platform group - discounts up to 85% on 2,743 brands
- [Академия здоровой жизни | Group on OK](https://ok.ru/academy.health): Healthy living academy group - wellness, fitness, recipes & health tips
- [Пропавшие животные: пропала найдена собака кошка | Group on OK](https://ok.ru/agatanews): Lost & found pets community - missing dogs, cats & animal rescue support
- [Федеральный Журнал Агробизнес | Group on OK](https://ok.ru/agbzmagazine): Agribusiness federal magazine - Russian agriculture news, forums & events
- [Ahmad Tea. Новости на блюдечке | Group on OK](https://ok.ru/ahmadtea): Ahmad Tea official group - tea recipes, desserts & beverage community

## Public Figures & Celebrities

- [Леонид Агутин | OK](https://ok.ru/agutinleonid): Leonid Agutin official profile - Russian musician & celebrity from Moscow
- [Андрей Чернышев | OK](https://ok.ru/achernyshev): Andrey Chernyshev profile - Federation Council politician from Bratsk
